title: svt_usb_agent real fields/ports and USB sequencer-layer API surface (virtual + system virtual sequencer)
summary: svt_usb_agent (svt_usb_agent.sv, class svt_usb_agent extends svt_agent) real public fields (all cleartext despite the file being 97% encrypted overall): shared_status (svt_usb_status), phys_lane[SVT_USB_NUM_PHY_LANES] and phys (svt_usb_physical), phys_adapter (svt_usb_physical_adapter), phys_mon_lane[]/phys_mon (svt_usb_physical_monitor), phys_adapter_mon, link (svt_usb_link), link_mon (svt_usb_link_monitor), prot (svt_usb_protocol), prot_mon (svt_usb_protocol_monitor), eusb2v2_phy_register_sets (UVM-only). SVT_USB_NUM_PHY_LANES = 2 (include/sverilog/svt_usb_common_defines.svi:179) confirming native 2-lane (Gen2x2) physical-layer support per agent side. CONFIRMED real (verifies/extends a prior finding): `SVT_XVM(seq_item_pull_port) #(svt_usb_agent_service) agent_service_in_port;` plus `svt_usb_agent_service agent_service_rcvd_q[$];` -- a typed uvm_seq_item_pull_port, not a generic port, pulling svt_usb_agent_service transaction objects; VMM equivalent field is subenv_service_in_chan. The agent's real non-virtual sequencer fields are: svt_usb_link_service_sequencer link_service_sequencer; svt_usb_transfer_sequencer xfer_sequencer; svt_usb_transfer_sequencer xfer_response_sequencer; svt_usb_protocol_service_sequencer prot_service_sequencer; svt_usb_agent_service_sequencer agent_service_sequencer; plus svt_usb_virtual_sequencer virt_sequencer (the per-agent virtual sequencer). Real agent extern methods: build_phase(uvm_phase phase) / build() [OVM], refresh_cfg(), abort_current_pm_transfer(svt_usb_protocol_service protocol_service) [Passive-Monitor only], reset_pm_ep_seqnum(svt_usb_protocol_service protocol_service) [Passive-Monitor only], set_expected_transfer(svt_usb_transfer xfer), task indicate_otg_ss_role_swap_completed(input bit success=0) [must be called when otg_role_swap_status is OTG_A_INITIATED_ROLE_SWAP_IN_PROGRESS or OTG_B_INITIATED_ROLE_SWAP_IN_PROGRESS], task usb4_disconnect_usb3() [USB4 tunnel-mode]. svt_usb_virtual_sequencer (svt_usb_virtual_sequencer.sv:10, extends svt_sequencer; file is ~100% readable at API level) holds by-reference fields for every layer's non-virtual sequencer: usb_ss_data_sequencer, usb_ss_data_sequencer_lane[SVT_USB_NUM_PHY_LANES], usb_adapter_packed_trans_sequencer (svt_usb_link_packed_transaction_sequencer), usb_20_data_sequencer, usb_ss_phys_service_sequencer[_lane[]], usb_adapter_phys_service_sequencer, usb_20_phys_service_sequencer, usb_ss_pkt_sequencer, usb_20_pkt_sequencer, link_service_sequencer, xfer_sequencer, xfer_response_sequencer, prot_service_sequencer, agent_service_sequencer, and `SVT_XVM(blocking_peek_port) #(svt_usb_transfer) transfer_out_port` (output port for transfers received by a Device agent). Its full method surface: new(name, parent), build_phase(uvm_phase)/build(), find_first_agent(sequence_item seq), get_shared_status(seq)/get_remote_shared_status(seq) -> svt_usb_status, get_layer_event_pool(seq, svt_usb_agent_configuration::stack_layer_enum layer, output event_pool) [task], reconfigure(svt_configuration cfg), get_cfg(ref svt_configuration cfg), get_err_check(seq, string checks_inst='err_check') -> svt_err_check. svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer (svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer.sv:10, extends svt_sequencer; also ~100% readable) is the env-level host+device(+hub) pairing sequencer with fields multi_host_virt_sequencer[], host_virt_sequencer, hub_virt_seqr[SVT_USB_NUM_HUB_INST] [SVT_USB_ENABLE_HUB_MODE only], dev_virt_sequencer, device_virt_sequencer[$] (per-cable queue, used only by usb_test_suite_svt testbenches not usb_svt), each a svt_usb_virtual_sequencer. Its full method surface: new(name,parent), find_host_agent(seq)/find_dev_agent(seq)/find_hub_agents(seq, output agents[SVT_USB_NUM_HUB_INST]), get_host_shared_status/get_host_remote_shared_status/get_dev_shared_status(seq, input int hub_port_id=-1)/get_dev_remote_shared_status, get_host_layer_event_pool/get_dev_layer_event_pool(seq, stack_layer_enum layer, output event_pool[, hub_port_id]) [tasks], get_host_cfg/get_dev_cfg(ref svt_configuration cfg[, hub_port_id]), get_host_err_check/get_dev_err_check(seq, checks_inst), get_dut_type() -> svt_usb_types::dut_type_enum, get_dut_model() -> svt_usb_agent_configuration::dut_model_enum, set_device_id(int unsigned device_id), update_dev_virt_sequencer(int cable_id). Doc-comment contract for get_dut_type/get_dut_model (verbatim): exactly one side (Host OR Device config, never both, never neither) must set svt_usb_agent_configuration::dut_model away from NOT_APPLICABLE to RTL (real RTL DUT) or VIP (DUT side emulated by VIP); violating this reports an error -- a checkable environment-wiring invariant. CORRECTION: no class literally named 'svt_usb_sequencer' exists; use svt_usb_virtual_sequencer (per-agent) or svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer (env-level) instead.
